subject: Fix clippy::needless_bool in BloomObject::validate_size (#128)
reason: The change rewrites BloomObject::validate_size from `if bytes > limit { return false; } true` to `bytes <= limit` to satisfy clippy::needless_bool. The two expressions are logically identical for every input, including the exact boundary bytes == BLOOM_MEMORY_LIMIT_PER_OBJECT (true in both versions). It is a pure refactor with no behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
